title: HumanGateRecord v1
description: The ONLY legitimate record of human approval. An ExecutionRequest may carry a `human_gate_ref` pointing to one of these, but must never carry the approval decision itself (`human_approved`/`approved` are PROHIBITED_AUTHORITY_FIELDS -- see prohibited_fields.ts). A future AEF independently resolves the referenced record and checks state=AUTHORIZED plus binding match; IVE never asserts approval.

request_id.description: Binding to the exact ExecutionRequest this gate covers.

action.description: Binding to the exact action -- a gate authorized for one action must not be reusable for a different one, even on the same request_id.

state.description: Valid transitions (enforced in validators.ts, not expressible in pure schema): REQUESTED -> REVIEW_REQUIRED -> (AUTHORIZED | REJECTED | EXPIRED); AUTHORIZED -> EXECUTED. Any other transition is invalid.

approver.description: Required when state is AUTHORIZED or REJECTED (enforced conditionally in validators.ts -- JSON Schema's if/then handles the simple case, see schema below). Must be type='user' or type='service' with a resolvable auth_ref -- never type='system' (a human gate approved by 'the system' is a contradiction).

decided_at.description: Required (non-null) exactly when state is AUTHORIZED, REJECTED, or EXPIRED.

expires_at.description: A gate left in REQUESTED/REVIEW_REQUIRED past this time must be treated as EXPIRED, never as a silent default of AUTHORIZED or DENIED -- the caller must poll/resolve, not assume.

audit_ref.description: Reference to durable, independent audit evidence of the human decision (e.g. an immutable log entry ID). Required when state is AUTHORIZED or REJECTED.
